pd_sisters_5.summary: Charlotta performs shawl tricks revealing Anya and Varya, then teases Pischin
Lubov frets over the estate sale; Varya insists Uncle bought it
Trofimov teases Varya about Lopakhin and she snaps back
Lubov gently urges Varya to marry Lopakhin if she likes him
Varya admits Lopakhin ignores her and dreams of a convent
Yasha reports Epikhodov broke a cue; Varya leaves in exasperation
Trofimov defends teasing Varya, claiming he and Anya are above love

s01048.summary: Dee-Dee hosts the quiet four a.m. show from the cornfield studio
Roland and Cal drift in; Cal mentions a nameless repeat caller
Dee-Dee takes the call; the caller dedicates a song to the three
The caller says they can see him as a flashlight points from the field
Dee-Dee steadily plays the request and the flashlight goes out

s01063.summary: Four thieves crouch in the clock museum as the lookout times the guard
Bartholomew teaches Kenji to follow the dust and clip the wire
Despina finds the dome's listening lock and cracks it by its rhythm
Seraphina orders go; they lift the dome, take the sun, reseal it
Midnight chimes erupt as the crew crouches, Kenji laughing aloud
The guard passes; relieved, Seraphina leads them calmly home

s01118.summary: Gwendolyn reads the keeper's logbooks in the fog-bound lighthouse
She finds a dead man's entry and a hidden line: he did not fall
The harbormaster reports an empty boat; Gwendolyn asks who lit the lamp
A floorboard creaks above, and Gwendolyn pockets the log and climbs

pd_dollhouse_2.summary: Nora swears the children to secrecy about Krogstad and sends them off
Alone, Nora cannot sew or settle, agitated by her fears
Nora dresses the tree, forcing herself to believe all is well
Helmer returns and Nora denies anyone came, then admits Krogstad did
Helmer scolds Nora for lying and pleading Krogstad's case
Helmer embraces her, drops the matter, and settles by the stove
After a pause Nora tentatively calls to Torvald

s00019.summary: Magnus leads the inspector, picker and stranger through the dark tunnel
Zuzu sees breathing gray mushrooms; Magnus insists they are not moving
The stranger shows the caps shrink from light and ignores her question
Abiola flags log discrepancies and Magnus walks faster
Zuzu finds half a boot wrapped in a hairnet on the floor
Magnus claims a picker quit last week without his boot
The stranger orders stillness as rustling stirs down the tunnel
The stranger reveals Magnus locked the gate; Abiola calls it a lie
Zuzu begs Magnus to open the gate
Magnus admits his keys open a door to whatever keeps it quiet
The stranger pulls out a steel canister and says they go the other way

s01071.summary: Stiff Adelaide visits Tobias's shop and remarks on its dust
A boy's shout prompts Adelaide to probe; Tobias's jaw tightens
Tobias offers tea and urges her gloves off; she nearly yields
Adelaide refers to her letter; Tobias burned it but knows
Adelaide asks him to light a lamp for her again and leaves
Tobias carefully wipes her glove smear from the dusty lamp

s00006.summary: A market rides a giant tortoise across the salt flats at dawn
The tortoise stops and Maeve orders everyone to hold wares and hush
Dominic grumbles about lost lanterns and trades jabs with Isolde
The shell groans, crates slide, and Perrin and Maeve shout to brace
The tortoise rises, lifting the whole market toward the sky

s01051.summary: Juniper runs the season's last press as the buyer wants a count
Colm hears breathing beneath the cider and everyone hears it too
Juniper and Beata deny a basement; the ground doesn't like digging
Juniper tastes the cider and orders Colm down; Beata says it's early
The breathing quickens and the barrel under Colm bulges outward
Everyone scatters; Juniper takes a mallet and sends them out quietly
Juniper stands over the creaking barrel, mallet raised, waiting

s01067.summary: Abigail counts ice blocks for the party while Tobias whittles
Abigail questions a stranger claiming to be a family friend
Told the Ashworths left, the stranger says he came for a sealed tin
He reveals he is Rupert Ashworth, supposedly dead in the Punjab
Tobias steps up with his knife as Rupert insists he wants the tin
Rupert smiles tiredly and all three turn as the door creaks

pd_sisters_3.summary: Anfisa rejoices at her comfortable old age in Olga's flat
Vershinin must go; Irina and Anfisa leave to find Masha
Vershinin and Olga say farewell, accepting they will likely never meet
Vershinin philosophizes about the future, checking his watch, waiting for Masha
Masha arrives and she and Vershinin face their goodbye

pd_dollhouse_0.summary: Nora comes home merrily with parcels, tips the porter, sneaks macaroons
Helmer calls out pet names while Nora hides her macaroons
Helmer chides her spending; Nora argues they can borrow now
Helmer lectures featherheaded Nora on debt and she droops
Helmer coaxes his sulking skylark and produces his purse

s01093.summary: Abernathy tells Peggy to start at eight with no repeats
Abernathy leaves and Tucker checks they are alone
Tucker hands Peggy a letter: she won the scholarship
Peggy learns Dad already read the letter and quietly put it back
Peggy wipes her eyes, starts the show, and takes the reel from Tucker

s01090.summary: Bruised Nell sits alone in the orchard eating a pear
Theo appears and tests her about the Dunnings and leaving
Nell offers a pear and they eat together in silence
Theo says his brother is gone; they listen to a fading song
A woman calls another name; Nell says it was a girl she was
Theo offers his hand and pulls Nell up
Mrs. Dunning appears, conflicted, as Theo steps protectively before Nell
Mrs. Dunning leaves the door open and the teens follow

s01073.summary: Opposing counsel Eli and Nadia spar over her lateness and a key
Nadia opens a box revealing an uninventoried ledger
The judge appears demanding why a sealed ledger is on the dock
Eli accuses Nadia of tampering; she says he moved it
Eli lunges for the ledger and boxes topple
Deputy Hale bursts in, hand on holster, ordering everyone to freeze
The judge stands Hale down and takes the ledger to chambers
Eli fears burial; Nadia says the judge is deciding who digs

s01039.summary: Nadia starts a balky washer with Marisol's tip
The three strangers banter about the snow that won't stop
Elderly Walter shuffles in and finds the change machine broken
Nadia gives Walter quarters and he loads his machine
Walter reveals his wife died and he never learned laundry
Tucker invites Walter to sit and they wait together quietly

s01026.summary: Captain Voss folds laundry and brushes off Amara's urging to rest
Koji reports a coolant drift he has fixed three times
Terrapin reports a pressure variance in the nursery near tolerance
Pell bursts in reporting banging inside the empty cold lock
The knocking repeats and Amara recognizes the medical emergency code
Terrapin refuses to unseal, citing Voss's forgotten order, denying all cancels
The knocking turns frantic; Voss grabs a wrench and runs

s01117.summary: Felix asks why Mama left; Babcia keeps stirring and says eat first
Babcia serves porridge and smooths his hair; Felix pulls away
Babcia explains Mama wanted a different life; this one isn't bad
Felix asks if she'll return; Babcia holds his hand and speaks of swallows

s01064.summary: Queen Idrissa and Balthazar stop Finnegan and deny his brother exists
Morgana strides from the fog and vouches for Finnegan
Morgana reveals she is the brother and the bridge hums

s01028.summary: Orsolya and Tavi drift through the derelict ring, hailing anyone aboard
Orsolya finds sabotaged wiring and hides it from Tavi
Seeing Tavi tremble, Orsolya gives him a screwdriver task
A thud sounds and Orsolya unconvincingly insists it was far
The noise grows; Orsolya announces their exit and tows Tavi to the airlock
A final polite knock; Orsolya seals the hatch and sits frozen

s01031.summary: Bertie rolls close and taunts Lou; Hiro gives her the lead
Lou knocks Bertie's ball away and takes the lead
Skip needles Bertie about her ninety-one losses
Bertie rolls the last ball and it stops dead on the pallino
Hiro declares Bertie the winner; she taunts Lou about a rematch

s00009.summary: Down nine in the final jam, Bruise laces up as Tamara watches
Tamara coaches Bruise not to force it and sends her to the line
Dot and Bruise trade jabs on the line as the ref demands quiet
Bruise and Dot lock eyes in silence until the whistle shrieks
